name: Diamond Matter

debut.episode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray

abilities: Crystal body durability (survived being slammed into a branch and swallowed by an alligator)
weaknesses: Strength reduced by his tiny size
Too small for physical combat, like Grey Matter
summary: A palm-sized Diamondhead with Grey Matter's brain: crystal skin and back spikes on a Galvan frame that slices swamp trees but can't punch anything.
notableFeats: Battled Heatbat, survived being eaten by an alligator and cut a path through swamp trees for the airboat (Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray)

appearances.firstEpisode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
notableEpisodes: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
appearances.designNotes: Grey Matter-sized body with Diamondhead's aquamarine crystal skin, back and head spikes, and Grey Matter's eyes and mouth; uniform white with black cuffs on the left, black with white cuffs on the right; Omnitrix on the chest.

scoring.rationale: Diamondhead's toughness and blade-limbs shrunk to Galvan scale, with most of Grey Matter's brains; useful for cutting and thinking, useless in a slugfest.

notes: Fusion of Diamondhead + Grey Matter (componentIds); one-episode OS accident.
